standard_prerequisites.name: The presentation theorem for algebraic spaces
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Theorem theorem-presentation, used at proof lines 1897-1899
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the algebraic space F' = U/R.

standard_prerequisites.name: Surjectivity of a flat, locally finitely presented representable map
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives surjectivity of U -> F as a map of sheaves.

core_obligations: Form R = U x_F U and check it is a scheme with etale projections (proof lines 1893-1896).
Apply the presentation theorem to obtain F' = U/R with surjective etale U -> F' (proof lines 1896-1899).
Compare F' with F through the canonical factorization and conclude F' = F (proof lines 1899-1904).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: a sheaf F on (Sch/S)_{fppf} admitting a map U -> F from a scheme which is representable, surjective and etale is an algebraic space (source lines 1884-1891). The proof sets R = U x_F U, observes that R is a scheme with etale projections because U -> F is representable and etale, applies the presentation theorem to get F' = U/R with U -> F' surjective etale, and uses the canonical factorization U -> F' -> F together with the surjectivity criterion to conclude F' = F.
